CONTENT
COMMENTS
BEST
MINE
NOTES
Read a description of a situation. Then write an e-mail about the situation. You will have 9 minutes. You should aim to write at 50-120 words. Write using complete sentences.
ITEM TEXT
You
went
to
a
restaurant
for
a
meal
over
the
weekend
and
accidentally
left
your
bag
behind
in
the
restaurant
.
Now
,
you
need
to
write
an
email
to
the
restaurant
manager
to
inquire
about
the
whereabouts
of
your
bag
.
The
email
should
include
the
following
information
:
1
.
Inform
the
restaurant
manager
of
the
time
and
specific
location
where
you
left
your
bag
.
2
.
Describe
the
characteristics
of
the
bag
.
3
.
Express
your
expectation
for
the
manager's
response
